parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: MatchMode
parameters.description:
Filters by the matching mode of the effective scope. Valid values:
- **UserGroupAll**: Takes effect for all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
- **UserGroupNormal**: Takes effect only for users in specified user groups.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Filters by enabled status. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: Enabled.
- **Disabled**: Disabled.

parameters.name: StrategyIds
parameters.description: The IDs of scheduled vulnerability scan policies used for filtering. A maximum of 100 IDs can be specified. Duplicate IDs are not allowed.

parameters.name: StrategyName
parameters.description: The policy name. Fuzzy match is supported. The name can be up to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: UserGroupId
parameters.description:
The user group ID. Used to filter records whose effective scope includes the specified user group. You can obtain the value from the following operation:
- [ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~): lists user groups.
